svg.title: Atoms & nuclear equations
svg.desc: Count particles: Proton +1, neutron 0, electron −1. Neutral: protons = electrons. Carbon-14: 6p, 8n, 6e. Isotopes share proton number; ions differ in electron count. Size & levels: Atom radius ≈ 10⁻¹⁰ m; nucleus less than 1/10,000 of that, holding almost all mass. Absorb radiation → higher electron level. Emit → lower. Removing an electron ionises the atom. Alpha scattering: Most pass straight → mostly empty space. Some deflect → positive repulsion. Very few return → mass and charge concentrated in tiny nucleus; plum pudding fails. Models develop: Indivisible sphere → electron discovery → plum pudding → nuclear atom. Bohr adds specific electron levels; later proton identification; Chadwick gives neutron evidence. Alpha & beta-minus: Alpha is ⁴₂He: daughter A−4, Z−2. Beta-minus: neutron → proton + emitted electron; daughter A unchanged, Z+1. Electron is from nucleus, not shell. Balance both numbers: ²³⁸₉₂U → ²³⁴₉₀Th + ⁴₂He. ¹⁴₆C → ¹⁴₇N + ⁰₋₁e. Totals of A and Z match on both sides. Gamma loses energy with no change in A or Z.

g.text: Most pass; very few turn back
